title: Opolis Plus
description: Opolis Plus is a vanilla plus experience with BBL Mods
body:
## __**Overview**__

Welcome back **Opolis Plus**, this is a brand new modpack for 26.1 acting as a vanilla plus pack with a handful of other mods including most of the BBL ones

Includes Casting, Core, Routers and more

## __**Gameplay Features**__

Play in the latest Minecraft versions with all the new stuff vanilla had like the Pale Garden, Bundles and the Tiny Takeover. Build amazing structures with all the blocks from the colors mod and automate with Routers and Utilities. The world is yours to craft to your desires. And smelt you ores with Casting mod. What will you do?

## __**Support**__

Join the BBL [Discord](https://discord.gg/benbenlaw) for support, report bugs and suggest features or additions. You can also support me on [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/benbenlaw) to gain Alpha access to Modpacks and Mods in dev
